definitions: A rare, progressive neurodegenerative disease characterized by the degeneration of nerve cells in the cerebral cortex and basal ganglia.
A tauopathy that causes a combination of Parkinsonian symptoms, dystonia, myoclonus, and cognitive impairment.
examples: Diagnosis of corticobasal degeneration can be challenging.
Corticobasal degeneration often presents with asymmetric symptoms.
